tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: The brand black. Page background in Ink, text colour in Paper. Text on `lime`.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The brand off-white. Text in Ink, page background in Paper. Never pure white.

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: The one accent. Panels, highlight bars behind a key word, the play mark, progress, focus. Text in `lime` only on `ink` (16:1). On `paper` use it as a fill with `ink` text, never as text.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and video background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, chips and panels sitting on `surface`.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headlines and body on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary lines, labels, timestamps on `surface` (5.3:1 in Ink, 4.7:1 in Paper).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, grid lines, card borders.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Alias of `lime` for components.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` fill.

tokens.name: grey-300
tokens.usage: Warm light grey: inactive UI, faint lines on Paper.

tokens.name: grey-500
tokens.usage: Warm mid grey from the promo: secondary type on Ink.

tokens.name: grey-700
tokens.usage: Warm dark grey: hairlines and raised panels on Ink.

styles.name: screen-hero
styles.usage: One or two words that carry the beat: hooks, payoffs.

styles.name: screen-emphasis
styles.usage: The single emphasised word next to `screen-hero`. Lime on Ink.

styles.name: screen-caption
styles.usage: Spoken-word captions, 1–3 words at a time.

styles.name: screen-label
styles.usage: Chips, UI labels, timestamps inside the frame. Uppercase.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Send us your raw clips. We send back a reel built to be watched.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, CTAs in small caps, metadata.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding, minimum page gutter.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between related blocks.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between sections; video safe margin at 1080 wide.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Hero breathing room; video top/bottom safe area at 1920 tall.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small tags, keyframe markers.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Video cards, panels, thumbnails (at 1080 wide: 24px).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large panels, end-card plates.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips and CTAs.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Video cards floating on a backdrop.
